title: e-component instance — prop-forwarding chain envelope: overridable-wrapping-override inside the overrides array
_comment: SPEC 2.0 (components controller WP) — the NESTED RE-EXPOSURE wire shape (editor resolve-overrides-chain / createOverrideValue, verified 4.2.1): when a wrapping component forwards its own prop into a nested instance, the instance's overrides item is an {"$$type":"overridable"} envelope whose override_key is the OUTER (exposed) key and whose origin_value is the plain {"$$type":"override"} envelope for the INNER key. The chain invariant under test (component-instance-prop-type.php validate_value): the wrapped override's schema_source.id must equal the instance's component_id. Requires the e_components module (schema-extender unions every prop — including the overrides item type — with overridable).
